summary_1line: From Mount Suvela, Rama’s monkey generals admire Lanka’s lush groves and behold the magnificent, heavily fortified city built atop Trikuta Mountain.

image_candidates.scene_text: From Mount Suvela, Rama and the monkey chiefs gaze across the sea at golden‑walled Lanka rising atop the towering Trikuta Mountain.
Bands of roaring monkeys rush toward the city, trampling the earth as frightened birds and deer scatter into the sky and forest.
The radiant city of Lanka gleams with gold and silver ramparts, tall cloudlike gates, and palaces beneath flowering trees alive with birds.
